sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
Adjustable Rakhi Design: Made to offer a comfortable fit and easy wear during Raksha Bandhan rituals.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Festive Charm Styling: Designed with decorative charm detailing to add a playful, meaningful, and celebration-ready look.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Rakhi Ritual Friendly: Perfect for tilak, aarti, sweets ceremony, pooja, gifting, and family celebrations.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Handcrafted Finish: Carefully finished to give the Rakhi a premium, festive, and meaningful look.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Tie the Rakhi gently around your brother’s wrist during the Raksha Bandhan ritual.
• Adjust the thread comfortably so it sits well without feeling too tight.
• Use it during Rakhi pooja, tilak, aarti, sweets ceremony, gifting, and festive celebrations.
• After the festival, it can be kept safely as a memory or worn as a meaningful festive accessory.
• Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and rough handling to maintain its shine, colour, and finish.
• Store separately in a dry pouch or box after use.

sections.heading: Product Description
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Raksha Bandhan is all about tying love, blessings, and protection around your little brother’s wrist — and the Nazaria Yellow Fish Kids Rakhi is made to make that moment cute, bright, and meaningful.

Designed with classic black beads, an evil eye nazaria bead, and a cheerful yellow fish charm, this Rakhi brings together protection, positivity, and playful festive happiness. The black beads give it a traditional nazaria-inspired look, while the evil eye bead is commonly associated with protection, good luck, and keeping negative vibes away.

The yellow fish Pendant represents joy, good luck, prosperity, flow, happiness, and positive movement — making this Rakhi a sweet festive blessing for your little brother’s bright journey ahead.

A Rakhi made not just to tie on the wrist, but to wrap your little brother in love, protection, good luck, happiness, and festive warmth.

Note: Slight variations in bead placement, charm placement, colour, texture, and handcrafted detailing may occur.

• Evil Eye/ Nazaria Bead - Traditionally associated with protection, good luck, and keeping negative vibes away.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. Is this Rakhi adjustable?

Yes, it is designed to offer a comfortable fit for different wrist sizes.

Q2. Can this Rakhi be worn by kids?

Yes, the soft thread and lightweight design make it comfortable for kids and brothers.

Q3. Can it be worn after Raksha Bandhan?

Yes, it can be worn as a meaningful festive accessory after the celebration.

Q4. Is this Rakhi good for gifting?

Yes, it is a thoughtful Raksha Bandhan gift with a festive and meaningful design.

Q5. What do the charms represent?

The charms add meaning, positivity, protection, good luck, blessings, and a playful festive touch to the Rakhi.

Q6. Is it handmade?

Yes, each Rakhi is carefully finished, so slight variations in charm placement, colour, and finish may occur.
